end.parentNote: Pari practised identifying non-metals as solids or gases and connecting them with everyday uses such as graphite in pencils, iodine in salt, and nitrogen in fertilisers. They used examples from breathing, dancing, pencils and food packets to explain ideas. There was a mix-up about whether plants release or take in oxygen at night; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to make a two-column note showing plant respiration versus photosynthesis, including when each occurs.
